title: Arrest memorable du Parlement de Tholose
author: Jean de Coras
description: Jean de Coras's 1572 account of the Martin Guerre case: the arrest of the Parlement de Tholose on the man who came back to Artigat as another man's husband, printed with Coras's hundred and eleven annotations. A diplomatic, line-by-line transcription of the French and an English translation, both still in progress, from the Cambridge University Library scans.
